**Step 1 — Scene:** A breakfast tray with fried eggs, sautéed mushrooms, toast, sliced strawberries, orange juice, and an individual yogurt.

**Step 2 — Vessels:** Main plate approximately 26 cm across (**531 cm²**); toast plate approximately 20 cm (**314 cm²**); strawberry bowl approximately 15 cm (**177 cm²**). The glass appears about 6 cm across internally; the yogurt cup about 6.5 cm.

**Steps 3–7 — Items, coverage, volume, weight, and energy:** Coverage is relative to each item’s own vessel. Cooking fat is included in the cooked-food energy estimates rather than counted separately; no separate butter or sauce is clearly visible.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Two fried eggs | 35% of main plate | 186 × 0.6 = 112 ml | 0.98 | 110 g | 195 | 215 kcal |
| Sautéed mushrooms | 30% of main plate | 159 × 1.5 = 239 ml | 0.60 | 143 g | 65 | 93 kcal |
| Toast, approximately three slices | 75% of toast plate | 236 × 1.35 = 319 ml | 0.30 | 96 g | 280 | 269 kcal |
| Sliced strawberries | 55% of bowl | 97 × 1.2 = 116 ml | 0.60 | 70 g | 32 | 22 kcal |
| Orange juice | 100% of glass cross-section | 28 × 8.5 = 238 ml | 1.04 | 248 g | 45 | 112 kcal |
| Yogurt, contents inferred from visible cup | 100% of cup cross-section | 33 × 3 = 99 ml | 1.03 | 102 g | 75 | 77 kcal |

**Coverage check:** Eggs and mushrooms together cover approximately **65% of the main plate**; toast covers about **75%** of its plate, and strawberries cover about **55%** of the bowl.

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **419 g of solid food**, plus **350 g of juice and yogurt**, is plausible for this tray. Estimated total: **769 g and 788 kcal**. The largest uncertainties are toast thickness, cooking fat, and the yogurt’s unseen contents.
